LESSON: HADITH ON ETIQUETTE OF EATING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.2: Hadith on Etiquette of Eating
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Hadith on Etiquette of Eating, part of Hadith in Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What do you do before eating? 2. What is the benefit of saying Bismillah while eating?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read the hadith: “...Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right, and eat

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Hadith on Etiquette of Eating together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: the skill of making connection is enhanced as learners role-play manners of eating.

• Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners demonstrate the etiquette of eating with peers.

Values:
• Respect, for other learners while demonstrating etiquette of eating together.

• Responsibility, accountability as learners role-play manners of eating.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-esteem as learners collaborate with peers to demonstrate the etiquette of eating.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Agriculture as learners demonstrate the etiquette of eating individually/in small groups.
